events_shape_ck.name: events_shape_ck
events_shape_ck.value:
(
        "events"."event_kind" = 'date_only'
        AND "events"."local_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "events"."end_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "events"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "events"."event_kind" = 'instant'
        AND "events"."local_date" IS NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."end_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" < "events"."end_at_utc"
        AND "events"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL
      )

events_cancelled_at_ck.name: events_cancelled_at_ck
events_cancelled_at_ck.value:
("events"."status" = 'active' AND "events"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("events"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "events"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_due_shape_ck.name: tasks_due_shape_ck
tasks_due_shape_ck.value:
(
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'none'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'date_only'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NOT NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'instant'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL
      )

tasks_completed_at_ck.name: tasks_completed_at_ck
tasks_completed_at_ck.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'open' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck.name: user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck
user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck.value:
("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" IS NULL)
          OR ("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
              AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
              AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" <> "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute")
